components.name: Primary action
components.description: Flexoki red primary pane for the action that asks to be pressed.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:var(--radius-md,0.7rem);font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,box-shadow 150ms ease-out,transform 150ms ease-out;border:1px solid var(--primary-edge,oklch(0.2 0 0 / 30%));background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary,oklch(0.2 0 0)) var(--primary-solid,88%),transparent);color:var(--primary-foreground,oklch(0.985 0 0));backdrop-filter:var(--glass-blur-control,blur(14px));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--primary-rim,oklch(1 0 0 / 30%)),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--primary-under,oklch(0 0 0 / 45%)),inset 0 0 0 1px var(--primary-inner,oklch(1 0 0 / 7%)),0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact,oklch(0.25 0.03 265 / 6%)),0 8px 18px -9px var(--glass-shade,oklch(0.3 0.06 265 / 28%))}.ds-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch,var(--primary,oklch(0.2 0 0)) calc(var(--primary-solid,88%) - 10%),transparent)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--foreground,oklch(0.16 0 0));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--primary-rim),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--primary-under),0 1px 1px var(--glass-contact)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.css: .ds-tabs{display:inline-flex;gap:0;height:32px;padding:3px;border-radius:var(--radius,0.875rem);background:var(--muted,oklch(0.3 0.02 265 / 7%));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px var(--well-shade,oklch(0.3 0.06 265 / 14%)),inset 0 -1px 0 var(--well-rim,oklch(1 0 0 / 85%))}.ds-tab{font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Geist Variable', sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-md,0.7rem);padding:2px 6px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted-foreground,oklch(0.47 0 0));cursor:pointer}.ds-tab[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--glass-control,oklch(1 0 0 / 55%));color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.16 0 0));border-color:var(--glass-edge,oklch(0.38 0.03 265 / 10%));box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 var(--glass-control-rim,oklch(1 0 0 / 80%)),0 1px 2px var(--glass-contact,oklch(0.25 0.03 265 / 6%))}.ds-tab:hover{color:var(--foreground,oklch(0.16 0 0))}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--foreground,oklch(0.16 0 0));outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tab,.ds-tabs{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

Writer settings

narrative.overview:
ZXing WASM Studio uses the Helianthus Solid Glass material: compact warm paper and ink panes, inset fields and an actual image or generated symbol as the visual center. Light and dark retain the same hierarchy. Local Geist interface text and Geist Mono technical data keep a dense workbench legible.

The finish lives at the edges: an upper rim, fine perimeter and contact shadow. Pane faces stay quiet so source artwork, editable content and results carry the attention. Controls remain compact and complete; hierarchy comes from alignment, section boundaries, weight and tone. The palette follows Flexoki by Steph Ango: paper and warm gray in light mode, charcoal and warm ink shades in dark mode, with red primary actions and focus, green success and explicit red errors.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral glass with edge lighting, restrained translucency and a clear thickness hierarchy.
Compact controls paired with a bounded, prominent image or symbol preview.
Proportional interface text and monospaced technical values.
One consistent control language across decoding, camera input and encoding.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use Flexoki red for primary actions, focus and selection, green for success, and blue for detected geometry. Error text uses a separate red step and an explicit message. Source artwork retains its own colors.

rules.name: The Data Type Rule
rules.body: Use Geist Mono for bytes, dimensions, durations, HEX, JSON and source diagnostics. Keep instructions, payload text and control labels in Geist.

rules.name: The Edge Finish Rule
rules.body: Keep pane faces neutral. Express glass through the existing rim, hairline, blur and contact shadow, preserving panel, card and popover thickness.

dos: Do reuse the copied Solid Glass stylesheet and Base UI components for matching controls.
Do preserve the same visual hierarchy in light and dark themes.
Do keep field labels visible and technical values readable in their established type roles.
Do fit source artwork and generated symbols without stretching or cropping their contents.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced motion and reduced transparency treatments.
donts: Don't replace the neutral workbench with decorative gradients across pane faces.
Don't tint symbol paper to match the surrounding theme.
Don't use detection green as a general action or navigation accent.
Don't enlarge ordinary headings into a display typography system that the workbench does not use.
Don't remove the edge treatment or stack extra borders around glass panes.
